# 14: Codex 成对采样估计与独立保存

**What to build:** 同报告的合格双窗口变化产生 ratio/left，独立 estimate 安全保存并在消费周期重置之外保留。

**Delivers:** P66

**Blocked by:** 04: 安全文件更新与锁恢复；13: Codex 响应 headers 与独立额度窗口

**Status:** ready-for-agent

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 只用同次来源报告成对读数，不拼 API/headers 或新旧窗口；5h 增至少 50pp，双窗口均正增且未饱和才形成采样。
- [ ] rollover/过期/时间异常重建 baseline；窗口可独立展示但不代表具备成对采样资格，无估计为 estimating…。
- [ ] baseline 即刻持久，ratio 最多每分钟保存；公共文件协调合并新 baseline 优先、已知 ratio 不降 null，不用消费 totals 分摊账户额度。
- [ ] 使用自造报告序列及独立预期通过 S2 验证边界/状态转换；真实独立 estimate 文件合并和重启读回验证保存，完整跨文档 P52 owner 为 24。
- [ ] 准备 P66 H2 的序列预期、脱敏现有读数及正常观察步骤；不额外消耗额度造样本，无足够真实样本如实待确认。
- [ ] 通过批准的生产公共 seam 观察行为，预期来自合同/规格、独立字面值或手算，不以被测实现重算；永久网络 tests 使用 mock。
- [ ] 使用隔离安装/配置/工作/Session/数据根，不操作正式 OMP；承接异步失败并保留够用脱敏证据，完成本票自动检查及材料准备，不因计划人工验收暂停可执行工作。

## Verification responsibility

本票负责所列 Delivers 的自动 coverage 与适用宿主贯通/证据准备；P58/P52 按本票具名责任执行。合同采用 Rapid iteration：H1/H2 及允许的条件性 H3 按原 Coverage 交用户确认，未确认不记通过；不改变承诺或免除实现/永久 tests。

tdd_result.description: Implement Codex paired sampling ratio estimate persistence

data.status: delivered-automatically; P66 H2 (real effect) prepared and awaiting user confirmation

delivered_behavior.summary: The Codex ratio/left measurement now exists as its own business module, fed only by the window pair a single report carried, shown beside the allowance windows, and persisted in an independent document at the storage root that a consumption reset never touches.
new_files: extensions/model-cost/shared-logic/codex-estimate.ts — the sampling rules (pure): one report's own pair is the only input; five-hour movement >= 50 points, both windows up, neither saturated; rollover by moved reset instant (or >1 point drop when no instant is comparable), five-hour age-out, impossible future capture; a known ratio is never withdrawn; remainingBudget(weeklyPercent, ratio).

extensions/model-cost/shared-logic/codex-estimate-store.ts — the independent codex-usage-estimate.json: load at initialization, baseline published at once, ratio refinement at most once a minute, merge by baseline capture instant inside the framework's coordinated scope (newer wins and is adopted; equal capture leaves the writer's; a known ratio is never dropped to null), best-effort publication that never rejects.
changed_files: extensions/model-cost/shared-logic/codex-quota.ts — each batch's own pair is handed to the measurement from the one parser, before merge; a batch carrying one window measures nothing (CodexQuotaInputs.estimate added).

extensions/model-cost/shared-logic/presentation/display.ts — ConsumptionPresenter.estimate(): {ratio?, left?, text} | undefined; the segment renders `estimating…` or `left≈N.N×5h · ratio≈R.R`, left recomputed from the displayed weekly percent.

extensions/model-cost/shared-logic/runtime.ts — builds the measurement beside the balance, reads its document during initialize (after the storage root's load, before the startup query), passes it to the quota and to the presentation, exposes it as runtime.estimate.
docs: extensions/model-cost/GLOSSARY.md — added Codex ratio measurement and Codex estimate document terms.

.scratch/model-cost-migration/assets/14-codex-ratio-estimate-h2-2026-10-13.md — H2 material: sequence expectations (hand-computed, 10 steps), sanitized existing real readings, normal observation steps, and the honest status of the human check.

criteria.criterion: Same-report paired readings only; no API/headers or window mixing; 5h increase >= 50pp, both windows positive, unsaturated
criteria.evidence: tests/model-cost/codex-estimate.test.ts: report-driven S2 cases 'a report's own pair is the only thing a sample may come from' (first pair -> estimating…; 10->60 / 2->7 -> ratio 10, left 9.3; 0->50 / 0->5 -> 10; single-window report pairs nothing and the untouched baseline still measures 60/12 = 5). Fault injection: removing the pair guard (pairing held windows) fails the single-window case; tightening the threshold to >50 fails the exactly-50 case.

criteria.criterion: rollover/expired/impossible time rebuilds the baseline; windows display independently but do not qualify a pair; no estimate -> estimating…
criteria.evidence: Same file: 'a crossed window boundary rebuilds the baseline and never withdraws the ratio' (moved 5h reset -> rebaseline, ratio kept, next sample only spans the new anchor; percentage-drop fallback with no instants; age-out exactly at 5h). Fault injection: a threshold mutation fails these cases, proving the assertions bind.

criteria.criterion: baseline persisted at once, ratio at most every minute; coordinated merge with newer baseline winning and a known ratio never dropped to null; no consumption totals used for allowance
criteria.evidence: Same file, 'the baseline is published at once and a ratio refinement waits a minute' (baseline with ratio null on disk; a refinement 30s later stays in memory while the file still holds null; the next one 61s later lands; a rebaselined window inside the minute lands at once) and 'a shared document merges by the baseline's capture instant' (newer on disk kept + adopted; older superseded with the document's ratio 20 written, never null; equal capture leaves the writer's measurement). Fault injections: disabling newer-baseline-wins fails the adoption case; dropping `?? onDisk?.ratio` fails the 'never dropped to nothing' case.

criteria.criterion: S2 verification with a self-made report sequence and independent expectations; real independent estimate file merge and restart read-back; complete cross-document P52 owner is ticket 24
criteria.evidence: All expectations are this file's own literals, hand-computed (e.g. 50/5 = 10, (100-7)/100*10 = 9.3, 50/4.5 = 11.1, 90/13 = 6.9231); readable timestamps are decoded back to the epochs they were written from. The document is real on disk: the store's own entry is awaited (runtime.estimate.observe, the same shape as ConsumptionStore.commit), then codex-usage-estimate.json is read; 'a restart continues the measurement the document carries' binds a second runtime over the same root and shows the stored ratio without relearning and keeps sampling from the stored baseline. Full cross-document P52 verification remains ticket 24's.

criteria.criterion: P66 H2 preparation: sequence expectations, sanitized existing readings, normal observation steps; no quota consumed to manufacture a sample; insufficient real samples reported as unconfirmed
criteria.evidence: .scratch/model-cost-migration/assets/14-codex-ratio-estimate-h2-2026-10-13.md — 10-step hand-computed sequence, the real, sanitized ~/.omp/cost-archive/codex-usage-estimate.json reading (5h 0%, 7d 65%, ratio 6.5333, captured 2026-10-13T08:22:06+08:00; read-only, not modified), isolated-install observation steps, and the explicit statement that the H2 item is unverified and that no quota was spent for it.

criteria.criterion: Observed through approved production public seams; expectations not recomputed from the implementation; permanent network tests use mocks
criteria.evidence: Report cases bind the real definition through the framework's public binding (port double) and read only runtime.presentation.estimate(); document cases drive the measurement's own entry (runtime.estimate.observe) and read the real file. The only substituted dependencies are the harness's ProviderAccess and the framework's single HTTP call, as every model-cost suite does; no permanent case reaches a network.

criteria.criterion: Isolated install/config/working/session/data roots; official OMP untouched; async failures carried with sanitized evidence; no pause for planned human checks
criteria.evidence: Every case uses a fresh mkdtempSync root passed as storageDir (the official ~/.omp/cost-archive is only read for the H2 material). A publication failure is swallowed by the store and observable: 'text that is not JSON is never overwritten, and the measurement carries on in memory' (the file stays byte-identical, the ratio stays in memory). No command or step in this ticket touched the official OMP environment.

verification_run.command: targeted fault injections (each applied, run, then reverted)
verification_run.result: (1) threshold `<` -> `<=`: 12 cases fail; (2) pair guard removed (held windows paired): the single-window case fails; (3) newer-baseline-wins disabled: the adoption case fails; (4) `settled.ratio ?? onDisk?.ratio` -> `settled.ratio`: the 'known ratio never dropped to nothing' case fails. One further mutation (reading the merged windows instead of the batch's own candidates) was behaviourally equivalent — the pair guard is what enforces the rule — and was recorded rather than kept.

unresolved_or_unverified.item: P66 H2 — the real ratio/left effect in normal use
unresolved_or_unverified.detail: Prepared but not judged by the agent; requires the user. No quota was consumed to manufacture a sample.

unresolved_or_unverified.item: Host fact that limits the real effect (not a defect of this ticket)
unresolved_or_unverified.detail: On the recorded OMP 18.5.0 baseline a real Codex Turn delivers no HTTP response facts (harness-support.md row turn.provider-response-boundary, measured by ticket 13's dock case), so in production only the once-per-process startup account API answer feeds a pair — one answer cannot qualify a sample by itself. Until a host patch or another approved channel exists, a real run is expected to read `estimating…`; the sampling/merge/persistence rules are exercised with reports fed exactly as an adapter feeds them. Reported so the H2 result is not misread as a code failure.

Reading the estimate document synchronously while the framework's replace is in flight stalls that publication on Windows/Bun, so the suite reads the file only after awaiting the store's own entry and never polls it per turn; other suites that poll a document being published may meet the same stall.
Full cross-document P52 verification is ticket 24's; this ticket covers the estimate document's own part (independent file, merge, restart read-back, non-destructive failure).

The native rendering of the Codex allowance/estimate line in the widget (P67's visual work) and consumption-reset behaviour toward the estimate (P33, ticket 19) are other tickets' scope; this ticket left the estimate file outside the consumption document, so nothing in a reset path reaches it.
